description: This file is a shell script library containing functions to manage CI/CD workflows across different platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.). It defines utility functions for CI environment handling, group management, skipping redundant builds, and setting up environment variables based on CI type. The script is used for automating build, test, and deployment processes in continuous integration pipelines.
